_source: Industry-Academia Conclave 2.0 (8 Aug 2026) BIRAC EDGE announcement by Dr. Debasis Nayak and BIRAC Call 23 outreach at IICE
name: BIRAC EDGE & Biotechnology Ignition Grant (BIG) Facilitation
provider: BIRAC, Department of Biotechnology (DBT), Govt. of India
oneLiner: Grant facilitation, proposal mentoring, and wet-lab incubation for biotechnology, biotherapeutics, and medical device innovators.

atAGlance.purpose: Proof-of-concept validation, preclinical studies, and prototype development in healthcare and bioengineering
atAGlance.fundingAgency: Biotechnology Industry Research Assistance Council (BIRAC), DBT, Govt. of India
atAGlance.expectedOutput: TRL 3-5 biotech prototype, preclinical validation dossier, and IP filing
atAGlance.whoCanApply: Individual biotech innovators, faculty spin-offs, and life-science startups under 5 years of incorporation

benefits: Grant-in-aid support up to ₹50 Lakh under BIRAC BIG norms for proof-of-concept validation
Pre-proposal review clinics with Dr. Debasis Nayak (BIRAC-EDGE Coordinator) and IISER Bhopal bioscience faculty
Wet-lab bench access and confocal/NMR/HRMS characterization at IISER Bhopal
eligibility: Individual scientists, clinicians, research scholars, or startups incorporated within the last 5 years.
Project proposal in healthcare, biotherapeutics, molecular diagnostics, industrial biotechnology, or clean bio-energy.
Mentored or hosted in collaboration with IISER Bhopal faculty and IICE bio-incubation facilities.
coveredUses: Consumables, reagents, cell lines, and small laboratory equipment.
Central Instrumentation Facility (CIF) analytical testing, CRO services, and patent filing costs.
Project manpower and domestic travel for regulatory/clinical consultations.
nonPermittedUses: Routine academic research without commercial translation milestones.

selectionSteps.label: Pre-Proposal Clinic
selectionSteps.detail: Mock review with IICE's BIRAC-EDGE Coordinator and bioscience faculty.

selectionSteps.label: National Call Defence
selectionSteps.detail: Submission to BIRAC portal and technical defence before the Expert Panel.
